mapper.select: WITH lo AS ( SELECT TRUNC(LEAST(NVL((SELECT MIN(STAT_DATE) FROM HEALTH_DAILY_SUMMARY), #{today}), NVL((SELECT MIN(STAT_DATE) FROM STEP_DAILY), #{today}), NVL((SELECT CAST(MIN(OCCURRED_AT) AS DATE) FROM ALERT_EVENT), #{today}), NVL((SELECT MIN(STAT_DATE) FROM POS_PRESENCE_DAILY), #{today})), 'MM') M FROM DUAL ), m AS ( SELECT ADD_MONTHS(lo.M, LEVEL - 1) M FROM lo CONNECT BY LEVEL <= MONTHS_BETWEEN(TRUNC(#{today}, 'MM'), lo.M) + 1 ) SELECT TO_CHAR(m.M, 'YYYY-MM') FROM m WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM HEALTH_DAILY_SUMMARY h WHERE h.STAT_DATE >= m.M AND h.STAT_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(m.M, 1)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM STEP_DAILY s WHERE s.STAT_DATE >= m.M AND s.STAT_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(m.M, 1)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ALERT_EVENT e WHERE e.OCCURRED_AT >= CAST(m.M AS TIMESTAMP) AND e.OCCURRED_AT < CAST(ADD_MONTHS(m.M, 1) AS TIMESTAMP) AND e.CATEGORY <> 'OTHER') OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM POS_PRESENCE_DAILY d WHERE d.STAT_DATE >= m.M AND d.STAT_DATE < ADD_MONTHS(m.M, 1)) ORDER BY m.M

SELECT p.JOB_KIND NAME, COUNT(*) CNT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CARD_CODE FROM POS_PRESENCE_DAILY WHERE STAT_DATE >= #{from} AND STAT_DATE < #{to}) d LEFT JOIN POS_PERSON p ON p.CARD_CODE = d.CARD_CODE GROUP BY p.JOB_KIND ORDER BY CNT DESC, NLSSORT(p.JOB_KIND, 'NLS_SORT=SCHINESE_PINYIN_M') NULLS LAST, p.JOB_KIND

SELECT p.DEPT NAME, COUNT(*) CNT FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CARD_CODE FROM HEALTH_DAILY_SUMMARY WHERE STAT_DATE >= #{from} AND STAT_DATE < #{to}) h LEFT JOIN POS_PERSON p ON p.CARD_CODE = h.CARD_CODE GROUP BY p.DEPT ORDER BY CNT DESC, NLSSORT(p.DEPT, 'NLS_SORT=SCHINESE_PINYIN_M') NULLS LAST, p.DEPT

SELECT METRIC, MAX(MAX_V) MAX_V, MIN(MIN_V) MIN_V, SUM(AVG_V * SAMPLE_COUNT) WEIGHTED_SUM, SUM(SAMPLE_COUNT) SAMPLES, COUNT(DISTINCT CARD_CODE) PERSONS FROM HEALTH_DAILY_SUMMARY WHERE STAT_DATE >= #{from} AND STAT_DATE < #{to} AND METRIC IN ('HEART_RATE', 'TEMPERATURE', 'SPO2') AND SAMPLE_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY METRIC
SELECT CATEGORY, COUNT(DISTINCT NVL(CARD_CODE, 'imei:' || DEVICE_IMEI)) PERSONS, COUNT(*) EVENTS FROM ALERT_EVENT WHERE GROUP BY CATEGORY
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT NVL(CARD_CODE, 'imei:' || DEVICE_IMEI)) FROM ALERT_EVENT WHERE

SELECT h.CARD_CODE, h.METRIC, h.DAYS, h.SAMPLES, h.NORMALS, h.MIN_V, h.MAX_V, p.PERSON_NAME, p.DEPT, NVL(k.GROUP_CODE, 'DEFAULT') GROUP_CODE FROM (SELECT CARD_CODE, METRIC, COUNT(*) DAYS, SUM(SAMPLE_COUNT) SAMPLES, SUM(NORMAL_COUNT) NORMALS, MIN(MIN_V) MIN_V, MAX(MAX_V) MAX_V FROM HEALTH_DAILY_SUMMARY WHERE STAT_DATE >= #{from} AND STAT_DATE < #{to} AND METRIC IN ('HEART_RATE', 'TEMPERATURE', 'SPO2') AND SAMPLE_COUNT > 0 GROUP BY CARD_CODE, METRIC) h LEFT JOIN POS_PERSON p ON p.CARD_CODE = h.CARD_CODE LEFT JOIN JOB_KIND_GROUP k ON k.JOB_KIND = p.JOB_KIND
SELECT GROUP_CODE, GROUP_NAME, MIN_EVAL_DAYS, RISK_EVENT_COUNT FROM JOB_GROUP ORDER BY CASE GROUP_CODE WHEN 'DEFAULT' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, SORT_NO, GROUP_CODE
SELECT GROUP_CODE, METRIC, LOW_LIMIT, HIGH_LIMIT, ENABLED, STABLE_PCT, UNSTABLE_PCT FROM ALERT_RULE WHERE METRIC IN ('HEART_RATE', 'TEMPERATURE', 'SPO2')

SELECT s.CARD_CODE, s.DAYS, s.TOTAL, p.PERSON_NAME, p.DEPT FROM (SELECT CARD_CODE, COUNT(*) DAYS, SUM(STEPS) TOTAL FROM STEP_DAILY WHERE STAT_DATE >= #{from} AND STAT_DATE < #{to} GROUP BY CARD_CODE) s LEFT JOIN POS_PERSON p ON p.CARD_CODE = s.CARD_CODE

SELECT e.CARD_CODE, e.CODE, e.EVENTS, p.PERSON_NAME, p.DEPT, NVL(k.GROUP_CODE, 'DEFAULT') GROUP_CODE FROM (SELECT CARD_CODE, CODE, COUNT(*) EVENTS FROM ALERT_EVENT WHERE AND CARD_CODE IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CARD_CODE, CODE) e LEFT JOIN POS_PERSON p ON p.CARD_CODE = e.CARD_CODE LEFT JOIN JOB_KIND_GROUP k ON k.JOB_KIND = p.JOB_KIND
